subject: Invoice handling during portal migration — split PO guidance
messages:
From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@acme-supplies.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@firstmile.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice channel during portal migration and split PO handling

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking a look — Acme is planning to migrate to Redwood's vendor portal on Oct 25. Until the portal is live for our suppliers we have a lot of invoices that reference multiple PO numbers on a single invoice (our billing system can emit a single CSV per invoice with several PO rows). A few quick questions to make sure the cutover is smooth: 

- During the migration window, should we continue to email invoices to procurement@acme-supplies.com or start uploading to the portal sandbox?
- If email fallback is required, what subject line conventions or subject tokens do you expect so automated routing can match to the right ledger/entity?
- How should we format a multi-PO invoice CSV so Redwood's ingest will create separate ledger matches for each PO (we can add a PO column per line but want to avoid rework)?
- Do you provide acknowledgements (ACK) for emailed invoices and what SLA should we expect?

I've attached a short sample showing two POs on one invoice (sample_invoice_multi_po.csv). Can you point us to the minimal field set you require for a successful ingest?

Appreciate the help — this migration is high-volume for us.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lewis
Procurement Operations
Acme Supplies
[Attachment: sample_invoice_multi_po.csv (csv)]

From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice channel during portal migration and split PO handling

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear note and sample. Short answers up front and then a recommended fallback plan: 

- Portal-first: yes, please use the portal sandbox where possible. For the migration window we support email fallback to invoices@redwood-invoice-backstop.com (this address will be monitored and processed automatically).
- Subject token: use the pattern "ACME|<entity>|INV|<invoice-number>|PO:<comma-separated-pos>" in the subject line — e.g. "ACME|US|INV|20281009-501|PO:12345,12346". That lets the parser route to the right payment entity and pick up multiple PO keys.
- CSV format: each line should include a PO column and a line_amount column. For multi-PO invoices keep one CSV per invoice where each row is an invoice line and has the same invoice_number value. We can accept either "invoice_number" or "invoice_id" as the identifier. Required headers we need: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, description, quantity, unit_price, currency, line_amount. Optional fields: tax_rate, tax_amount, remittance_reference.
- ACKs: emailed invoices via the fallback address will receive an automated receipt (ACK) within 24 hours; if parsing fails you'll get an error email with the failure reason and a short remediation guide.

I'll loop in Jordan (on onboarding) to propose the minimal schema and a sample CSV that matches our production parser.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)]

From: jordan.blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice channel during portal migration and split PO handling

Sara — forwarding a proposed minimal CSV layout and a couple of practical rules from our ops team. I'm pasting the minimal sample below and attaching a ready-to-send minimal_lineitem_sample.csv you can use to test.

--- Forwarded message ---
On Tue, Oct 10, 2028 at 10:45 AM naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Sara — thanks for the clear note and sample. Short answers up front...

Operational rules: 
1) One invoice per file (even if multiple POs are referenced) — makes reconciliation and ACKs deterministic.
2) Keep invoice_number constant across rows. Each row must include po_number. Duplicate PO rows are allowed if the invoice legitimately contains multiple lines for the same PO.
3) Currency is required and must be ISO (USD, EUR). If VAT/tax lines exist include tax_rate and tax_amount per row; otherwise include a single summary tax row at end with type=tax.

Minimal CSV header (order not strictly enforced, but headers must match): invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount, currency, tax_amount, tax_rate, remittance_reference

Example (CSV body):
"INV-20281009-501",2028-10-09,12345,"Widget A",2,12.50,25.00,USD,2.50,0.10,"WIRE-REF-88"
"INV-20281009-501",2028-10-09,12346,"Widget B",1,50.00,50.00,USD,5.00,0.10,"WIRE-REF-88"

Attachments: [minimal_lineitem_sample.csv (csv)]

Jordan Blake
Onboarding Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@acme-supplies.com>

Subject: Re: Invoice channel during portal migration and split PO handling

Thanks Jordan — that layout looks good and mirrors what our ERP emits. A couple more items before cutover: 

- ACK SLA: 24 hours is fine. Can we get a short success/failure schema so our system can ingest the ACKs and mark invoices as submitted? (e.g., ACK returns invoice_number, status, error_code)
- VAT: we include VAT as per-line tax_amount in our current export. If the parser accepts per-line tax_amount that's perfect.
- Remittance: can Redwood include remittance_reference back in the ACK so we can reconcile automatically?

If we get a sandbox endpoint for the portal and one test email address to send to (and the sample CSV processed successfully), we can schedule the final migration for Oct 25.

—Sara
Sara Lewis
Procurement Operations
Acme Supplies

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@acme-supplies.com>

Subject: Re: Invoice channel during portal migration and split PO handling

Hi Sara — thanks, this is all actionable. Final summary and next steps: 

1) Sandbox endpoints we will provide by EOD Oct 12: portal sandbox link (invite sent) and email fallback inbox invoices@redwood-invoice-backstop.com.
2) ACK schema: we'll send JSON ACKs to the contact listed in vendor_onboarding_form.pdf with fields {invoice_number, status: [received|parsed|error], error_code (if any), remittance_reference}. We'll attach a small sample ACK payload in the sandbox results.
3) VAT: per-line tax_amount is supported and preferred.
4) Remittance_reference will be echoed back in the ACK to help with reconciliation.
5) Onboarding steps: please complete the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and upload to the portal; Jordan will run two sample files through the sandbox (one multi-PO file and one single-PO file).

Proposed go-live: Oct 25 (we'll switch to portal-first, email fallback monitored for 2 weeks). Onboarding owner: Jordan Blake (jordan.blake@redwood.ai). If you want, we can set a short check-in on Oct 26 to confirm ACK rates.

Links: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/Acme-Onboarding-Form (vendor_onboarding_form.pdf)
HubSpot: HS-12345

Thanks again — I'll send the portal invite and test email address shortly.

Best,
